Element: Moon. VFX: to the sky: the forehead moon glows and passes through its phases over 30 s
(the glow cycle: periwinkle, full-moon white, deep violet); the mane tips, the flank runes, the
leg marks, the tail's core and the chain's broken ends glow with it; moon-dust motes orbit at
1.5 studs; a ground ring of runes turning once in 12 s; a moonlit mist (the cold light) round
the body; a moon-dust trail while it runs; the flourish is the howl: the head goes up, the moon
flares and a beam of moonlight stands from the orb into the sky (Effects.luau: Light, the Wisp
